from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class QuarterlyCurrentAssets(BaseModel):
    """One quarterly financial data point for current assets from a financial report."""
    company: str = Field(description="The company name, as named in the task")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the quarter ends, e.g. '2021-03-31'")
    fiscal_year: int | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the quarter belongs to")
    fiscal_quarter: int | None = Field(description="The fiscal quarter (1=Q1, 2=Q2, 3=Q3, 4=Q4)")
    current_assets_total: float | None = Field(description="The current assets total reported for this period")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the amount, e.g. 'CNY', '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    quarterly_current_assets: list[QuarterlyCurrentAssets]
